result.rationale: Ontario Science Partners General Partnership is one active DBFM ProjectCo. Direct sources establish John Laing's 64%, Sacyr Infrastructure Canada's 26% and Amico Major Projects' 10% interests at the February 11, 2026 financial close. The 2021 John Laing takeover terms reserve future investments to KKR, so this new 2026 project is outside the legacy JLIL/Equitix portfolio and the existing Equitix attribution must be corrected.

evidence.purpose: Direct sponsor evidence for financial close, the 64%/26%/10% split, value and concession term.
Current portfolio evidence for the sponsor split, construction status and 2029 target opening.
Regulatory evidence that future John Laing investments were fully KKR-owned while Equitix received only the legacy portfolio.
